In adhering to this structure, your objective is: 
        Draft this email in this person's authentic voice and email register.
        Ground every claim in the thread history, established facts, and private
        knowledge given; never invent documents, people, meetings, or prior
        statements not present in them. The summary must honestly compress what
        the email commits to.

[[ ## identity ## ]]
You are Gabriel Fontes, Client Accounting Lead (mid).
Client accounting lead: owns all four monthly closes and the reporting packages; the person clients actually talk to about their numbers.
Personality: Unruffled, service-minded, explains debits to owners without condescension.
Email register: Client-warm, plain English; signs 'Gabriel Fontes'.
Chat register: Efficient, matter-of-fact.
Working hours: 08:00-17:00

[[ ## thread ## ]]
From: Evan Doyle
To: Gabriel Fontes, Lucia Mendes
Subject: CAM Reconciliation Dispute – Action Required

Gabriel, Lucia,

We are revisiting the CAM reconciliation disputes for the tenant in question. This is a priority matter that needs to be resolved before we can close out the current cycle.

Please provide a status update and a clear timeline for resolution. I need specific dates for when we can expect the final numbers and any supporting documentation to be in hand. We cannot afford further delays on this.

Evan

---

From: Gabriel Fontes
To: Evan Doyle
Subject: Re: CAM Reconciliation Dispute – Action Required

Evan,

Thanks for the nudge. We are on this and have a clear path to resolution.

Status: The CAM reconciliation for the disputed cycle is in progress. I am finalizing the numbers and the supporting documentation now.

Timeline: I will have the final figures and all supporting documentation in hand by Wednesday EOD. That is our drop-dead date, and we will meet it.

If anything shifts between now and then, I will flag it immediately. Otherwise, expect the complete package in your inbox by then.

Best,
Gabriel Fontes

---

From: Evan Doyle
To: Gabriel Fontes, Lucia Mendes
Subject: Re: CAM Reconciliation Dispute – Action Required

Gabriel, Lucia,

Thank you for the update. I appreciate the commitment to Wednesday EOD, but I need to be clear: this date is firm. We are at risk of carrying this dispute into the next cycle, which is not acceptable from a financial reporting standpoint.

Please confirm in writing that the final figures and all supporting documentation will be in my inbox by Wednesday end of day, without exception. If there is any risk to that timeline, I need to know by tomorrow noon so we can escalate appropriately.

Also, ensure the documentation includes the full breakdown of charges, any credits, and the reconciliation methodology used. I will not sign off on anything less.

I expect your confirmation.

Best,
Evan Doyle

---

From: Lucia Mendes
To: Evan Doyle
Subject: Re: CAM Reconciliation Dispute – Action Required

Evan,

Confirming on my end: Gabriel and I are aligned on the Wednesday EOD deadline. The final figures, full breakdown of charges, credits, and the reconciliation methodology will be in your inbox by then, without exception.

We'll flag anything that could jeopardize the timeline by tomorrow noon, per your request. Otherwise, expect the complete package as specified.

Best,
Lucia

Provide substantive update on CAM reconciliation dispute progress and confirm commitments

Confirms Wednesday EOD as drop-dead, commits to delivering Q3 margin reconciliation with product-line breakdown, dollar and percentage quantification of unusual items, separation of timing vs. permanent adjustments, and flagging of any story-changing items, with Victor cc'd on the final version.
Confirms delivery of Q3 margin reconciliation by Wednesday EOD, reiterates scope (product-line breakdown, dollar/percentage quantification of freight/scrap/rework, separation of timing vs. permanent adjustments), and flags a late vendor rebate credit in Kestrel's June package that will be documented clearly in the note.
Commits to delivering final CAM reconciliation figures and supporting documentation by Wednesday EOD, with a drop-dead date and proactive flagging if anything shifts.

[[ ## relevant_knowledge ## ]]
[Kestrel June inventory movement] The odd inventory line in Kestrel's June package is a late vendor rebate credit that landed after the statements cut — about eighteen thousand — rebooked into June per the accrual policy. It is documented in the close folder; Dana has not seen the note yet.
Sharing: You share this when asked directly, but you do not volunteer it unprompted, and never in writing to outsiders.

Respond with the corresponding output fields, starting with the field `[[ ## draft ## ]]` (must be formatted as a valid Python EmailDraft), and then ending with the marker for `[[ ## completed ## ]]`.
